scope: Directed primary-source search for balance of determinant maximizers, moment/microstate control uniform over amplifications, and sharpness of the C/e comparison. No proofs changed and no scores assigned.

target_definition.F_infinity: sup_m max_{sum_i tau_m(Y_i*Y_i)=1} |det(sum_i A_i tensor Y_i)|^(2/(Dm))
target_definition.sharpness_claim: For every K<e there is a finite complex tuple, optionally with exact Gram I, with C(A)>K F_infinity(A).

findings.balance: Exact component already present in the same author's public antisymmetric preprint; external scaling/moment-map literature supplies the earlier method.
findings.uniformity: Trace-polynomial and matrix-coefficient moment methods are established. No exact external statement of the present regularized determinant bound uniformly over every m was located.
findings.factor_e: The free determinant constant is established by Mai-Speicher. The finite amplified global sharpness conclusion was not located in the external primary sources inspected.
findings.potential_contribution: The specific combination of balanced maximizers, a uniform regularized moment bound, and the Ginibre capacity-root lower bound 1-O(s^(-1/2)), with high probability as D tends to infinity for each sufficiently large fixed s, followed by s tending to infinity. This remains a candidate contribution, not a certified priority claim.

sources.title: Alternating minimization, scaling algorithms, and the null-cone problem from invariant theory
sources.finding: Marginal inverse-square-root normalization and AM-GM minimize orbit norm; Kempf-Ness identifies balanced marginals. The determinant maximizer argument is an elementary specialization of this scaling principle, not this paper's stated optimization problem.

sources.authors: Bürgisser, Franks, Garg, Oliveira, Walter, Wigderson
sources.title: Towards a theory of non-commutative optimization: geodesic first and second order methods for moment maps and polytopes
sources.finding: Norm minimization along group orbits and vanishing moment map explain balance at critical points. No exact global F_infinity/C sharpness theorem identified in the inspected passages.

sources.title: Sharp determinant bounds for amplified antisymmetric channels and a noise law for noncommutative rank
sources.finding: Lemma 2 states both auxiliary balance identities at every nonsingular determinant maximum. Lemmas 4-5 apply trace moments and a logarithmic majorant uniformly in the auxiliary size. This is a public predecessor from the same research program, not independent confirmation.
sources.inspection: Primary 9-page PDF, relevant statements and proofs read.
sources.hash_status: Checksum displayed by publisher record; not freshly hashed locally in this bibliography turn.

sources.title: Fuglede-Kadison determinants of matrix-valued semicircular elements and capacity estimates
sources.finding: The free determinant-capacity identity and the semicircle law for unital covariance are prior results. Their e^(-1/2) factor becomes e^(-1) after squaring the determinant. This does not alone upper-bound the supremum over every finite auxiliary tuple or prove its sharpness.
sources.inspection: Primary HTML statements and surrounding arguments read.

sources.title: Norm of matrix-valued polynomials in random unitaries and permutations
sources.finding: Dimension-free tracial moment/Schatten estimates precede operator norm comparison with growing coefficient matrices. Corollary 1.2 restricts coefficient size n to exp(N^(1/(32d+160))). It is not unrestricted-amplification operator norm convergence and not an exact F_infinity theorem.
sources.inspection: Primary PDF statements and proof overview read.

sources.title: Conditional Expectation, Entropy, and Transport for Convex Gibbs Laws in Free Probability
sources.finding: Uniform approximation by trace polynomials on operator norm balls, including suprema over matrix sizes and microstate limits, is an established framework. The specific tensor coefficient word estimate for regularized F_infinity is not located as a stated theorem here.
sources.inspection: Primary publisher full-text HTML sections read.

sources.authors: Tsz Chiu Kwok, Lap Chi Lau, Akshay Ramachandran
sources.title: Spectral Analysis of Matrix Scaling and Operator Scaling
sources.finding: The capacity bound in Theorem 1.8 inherits lambda^2 >= C epsilon log D. Fixed s and epsilon of order s^(-1/2) do not satisfy that condition as D grows. Its initial statement uses real matrices, and its square-case capacity equals D times the determinant-capacity root used here.
sources.inspection: Both arXiv statements and the previously saved published PDF checked.
sources.prohibited_inference: Do not drop the logarithmic hypothesis, import the theorem into the complex case without justification, or confuse its capacity scale with the present definition.

sources.title: Rigorous Guarantees for Tyler's M-Estimator via Quantum Expansion
sources.finding: The operator norm scaling theorem retains small epsilon log p/lambda^2; the Frobenius variant requires small epsilon sqrt(p)/lambda. The convergence theorem's gradient is unnormalized Frobenius. These results do not by themselves provide the fixed-s Ginibre capacity claim.

sources.authors: Carlos E. González-Guillén, Marius Junge, Ion Nechita
sources.title: On the spectral gap of random quantum channels
sources.finding: The Gaussian decoupling and moment estimate are established inputs, not a novelty claim. The direct fixed-s Ginibre capacity consequence additionally needs the deterministic cut argument.
sources.inspection: Primary PDF read and page 10 visually checked during the immediately preceding capacity audit; not re-audited in full here.

sources.title: Van der Waerden/Schrijver-Valiant like Conjectures and Stable (aka Hyperbolic) Homogeneous Polynomials: One Theorem for all
sources.finding: Stable-polynomial capacity bounds coefficients/permanents with factor n!/n^n, whose nth root tends to e^(-1). This is a different capacity and a coefficient functional, not the amplified determinant optimum. No reduction equating the two sharpness problems was established.
sources.inspection: Primary PDF theorem and examples read.

sources.title: Capacity Lower Bounds via Productization
sources.finding: Productization and marginal conditions control stable-polynomial capacity. The homogeneous bound requires total l1 marginal error below 2, which need not follow from a dimension-independent operator norm balance error. The inspected result is not the same depolarizing-mixing cut lemma.
sources.inspection: Primary PDF statements and productization argument read.

sources.title: The non-commutative Khintchine inequalities for 0 < p < 1
sources.finding: Khintchine inequalities include free random sequences and noncommutative Lp for p>0. No p=0 determinant-capacity identity or sharp universal amplified comparison was identified; one cannot infer a sharp logarithmic endpoint merely by sending p to zero.
sources.inspection: Primary PDF introduction and main inequality setup read; no exhaustive theorem-by-theorem audit.

sources.title: A universal capacity bound for amplified determinants and polynomial witnesses in the Hermitian case
sources.finding: The indexed primary record states C/e <= F_infinity <= C and explicitly does not claim an optimal constant. This is the same-program comparison being sharpened, not external priority evidence.
sources.inspection: Primary record content returned by search. Direct page/PDF opens failed; no full-PDF audit claimed.

sources.title: A dimension-independent capacity bound for amplified determinants of Hermitian matrix tuples
sources.finding: The Hermitian positive-span comparison and bounded regularized-log finite-witness transfer are already part of this research program. They are distinct from the new global sharpness assertion.
sources.inspection: Primary version record read; no new full-PDF audit.

access_limits: The search is directed, not exhaustive: no complete MathSciNet, zbMATH, citation-index, or author-network search.
Most narrow phrase queries returned irrelevant communication-capacity or ordinary determinant-optimization results; absence of hits is weak evidence.
New 2026 frame-expansion paper at OpenReview id 6LRj4ppKWp appeared in search but full text was blocked by a browser challenge; no theorem from it is used.
Direct page/PDF access to the same-author universal-comparison deposit failed, although its primary record text was returned in search.
Kempf-Ness 1979 original text was not retrieved; attribution checked through primary later research papers, not claimed as direct original-source inspection.
Only specified sections of larger papers were inspected; neither the complete literature nor all proofs were re-reviewed.
excluded_false_matches: Shannon/MIMO channel capacity with log determinants.
Ordered noncommutative determinants over finite-dimensional algebras.
Principal-submatrix determinant maximization and experimental-design MAXDET.
Permanent or mixed-discriminant constants without a demonstrated reduction to F_infinity.
